faq: What should a house sitter do on each visit?

Usually: bring in mail and packages, check for leaks or anything unusual, water plants on schedule, change which lights are on, and lock up. Put your own list in the "Each visit" box so nothing gets skipped.
Should I turn off the heat when I'm away in winter?
Most people leave it on at a low setting so pipes don't freeze. Check what's right for your home and climate, and write the setting on the sheet so your sitter doesn't change it.

Should I write my alarm code here?
We'd recommend against it. Give codes to your sitter in person or by text.
